svg.title: Boot and power troubleshooting flowchart
svg.desc: A troubleshooting flowchart for a KIPR controller that will not turn on or turns off randomly. Check the red power light, then follow the powered or unpowered branch.
svg.text: Controller won't turn on or turns off randomly
Turn the controller's power switch on.
Look for the red power light in the bottom-right corner.
Controller does not boot or shuts off unexpectedly
Is the red power light on?
This separates boot problems from power-delivery problems.
The board is properly receiving power.

a.text: Save your work before changing the SD card.
2. Write a fresh image to the SD card

svg.text: Email support@kipr.org so the support team
Confirm the battery is fully charged,
Email support@kipr.org so the support team
